critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 978 lines - consider splitting reports/pdf/xlsx helpers into a separate module.
STATUS_OPTIONS constant is defined but not enforced by Pydantic — backend accepts any status string. Consider using Literal[...] for validation.

In _build_xlsx the min_widths logic uses min(longest, min_widths[key]) which effectively caps the width at the floor - this appears to be intentional as a hard cap for wrapping, but the naming is misleading (min_widths acts as both a floor via max() and a ceiling via min()).
